_comment: ISOLATED DEMO/MOCK MARKET OVERLAY (Issue #8.5 + Issue #13). Synthetic AUTO routes for the local web E2E demo only. This directory is loaded ONLY when execution_mode=mock (see app/demo/runtime.py) and NEVER for live execution, so it never affects real market counts, dedup metrics, registry reporting, or market coverage. mock-insurer + mock-insurer-broker intentionally share one distinct_rate_source_id so Issue #4 dedup marks the broker as a confirmed duplicate alternative (Duplicate rate source) while mock-insurer is the executable primary; in Issue #13 mock runs the broker route is executed so a confirmed duplicate quote is VISIBLE (Issue #12 keeps the direct as representative). mock-provider-c maps to the mock CAPTCHA page; mock-provider-d maps to the estimate page. status stays 'discovered' (never 'verified') so the Issue #7 live gate always refuses them.
